arguments.message:
Hi there,

When two people from the same company both claim to own a workspace, Meridian treats this as an internal company matter. We don’t take either side’s word for it. Instead, a human reviewer will handle the case — but only after the company provides documentation or a statement from someone in a position of authority over both parties (e.g., a manager or legal representative). 

To start the process, either party should contact our support team with their account details and any relevant proof of authority. Our reviewer will then pause the review until the required confirmation is received, and will work with you case‑by‑case to resolve the dispute.

Let us know if you’d like to begin the review or need help gathering the needed documentation.
